enabled.description: Whether a JSON or XML document opened in a view is shown as a tree. Takes effect in documents loaded after the change.

maxBytes.description: The largest document shown as a tree, in bytes; a larger one stays plain text with a notice.

defaultView.description: Whether a document opens as a tree or as its raw text.

expandDepth.description: How many levels of the tree are open when a document opens; a large document opens fewer (at most 5000 rows below the top).

theme.description: The viewer's colours; auto follows the view's prefers-color-scheme.
